info.title: FSharp.ViewEngine.Cli
info.description: Install consumer-owned FSharp.ViewEngine component source in deterministic F# compile order.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Install and compare consumer-owned FSharp.ViewEngine component source.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize or select a consumer-owned F# Components project.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Namespace root for copied component source. Defaults to the project name.

options.name: --framework
options.description: Target framework for a newly created project: net8.0, net9.0, or net10.0.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add selected components and their transitive source dependencies.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Explicitly replace conflicting managed source and project entries. [default: False]

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare installed source with this tool's embedded registry version.
